description:
[Market] Every way to sell one skin, and what each pays. The "Where to sell" table from the skin's page: `instant` - every buy order or site buyback you can sell into
now (`venue`, `label`, `gross` and `net` cents after the site's `fee` %, `count` it will take, `buyback`,
`url`); `list` - what listing it and waiting would bring (`gross`, `net`, `fee`, recent `sold` count over
`days`); and `best_cash` - the best instant cash payout (Steam's is wallet money, not cash). `found=false` when
no marketplace currently bids or lists it. Every buy order / buyback / listing estimate for one skin, after fees. Find itemdefids with search.

itemdefid.description: The skin's item definition id (find it with `/skins/search`).
